notes.bits: bit strings are 70 characters 0/1, header bit 0 first, as they appear in the cells of the copy (masked)
notes.cells: frame cells: data cells hold the palette index 0..2^bpc-1; finder, corner, separator, marker and header cells hold 8 = ink, 9 = paper
notes.crcOfInts: a *Crc32 of an integer list is the CRC-32 of the list as little-endian u32 values
notes.decode: an entry with "error" must be discarded; the name of the defect is informative (implementations need not report it)
notes.streams: push = action of PROTOCOL §11.2 (discard, keep, add, accept, refuse) for the transfer key of the packet; finish = decode what can be decoded and, when every block is decoded, do the file check of §11.3 for the key of the last pushed packet; state = state of that key

decode.name: valid, byte-order mark kept in the name
valid, bytes after the end of the TLV list ignored
valid, TLV record ends at the last byte

streams.name: wrong symbol: check fails, transfer starts again
different descriptor for the same key
refused: larger than the receiver limit
limit on transfer keys: the least recent key is reset
DEFLATE, output longer than the file size
DEFLATE, byte after the final block
DEFLATE, stream ends before the final block

differential.note: digests of the outcomes of the reference decoders on the corpora of test/corpus.js (src/rust/tests/corpus.rs)

referenceSender.note: the choices of the reference sender (PROTOCOL §10.2, §10.3); not part of conformance
